definitions.explanation: Representing the standard or norm for a group. Can be neutral (statistically average) or slightly negative (unremarkable, nothing special).

examples.japanese: {平均的|へいきんてき}な{日本人|にほんじん}の{身長|しんちょう}はどれくらいですか。
examples.english: What is the average height of a Japanese person?

examples.japanese: {平均的|へいきんてき}な{家庭|かてい}の{収入|しゅうにゅう}は{年々|ねんねん}{変化|へんか}している。
examples.english: The income of the average household changes year by year.

examples.japanese: {成績|せいせき}は{平均的|へいきんてき}だが、{部活動|ぶかつどう}では{目覚|めざ}ましい{活躍|かつやく}を{見|み}せている。
examples.english: His grades are average, but he's shown remarkable performance in club activities.

notes:
Formed from {平均|へいきん} (average) with the suffix {的|てき} (forming na-adjectives). A very productive pattern in Japanese — {基本的|きほんてき} (basic), {一般的|いっぱんてき} (general), {典型的|てんけいてき} (typical) all follow the same structure.

USAGE:
Used as a na-adjective modifier ({平均的|へいきんてき}な + noun) or as an adverb ({平均的|へいきんてき}に). Can describe statistical averages or, more loosely, what is considered normal or ordinary.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {平均的|へいきんてき}な{体格|たいかく}: an average build
- {平均的|へいきんてき}な{収入|しゅうにゅう}: an average income
- {平均的|へいきんてき}な{日本人|にほんじん}: the average Japanese person
- {平均的|へいきんてき}に{見|み}て: looking at it on average

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {普通|ふつう}の: normal, ordinary — more colloquial and broader, covering social norms as well as averages
- {標準的|ひょうじゅんてき}な: standard — implies conforming to an established norm or benchmark
- {一般的|いっぱんてき}な: general, common — focuses on what is widely seen or accepted
